messages:
Maya (docs): Quick pass on Optimize toolkit pages: some code examples use the old client shape and theres an inconsistent name for the 4-bit quant profile. Opening a tiny PR to standardize snippets + add a migration note.
Diego (eng-ml): Which pages? I saw runtime logs show 'q4f' but our shipped examples use 'q4_0'. We should pick one canonical name in docs and map aliases.
Maya (docs): Plan: canonicalize on 'q4_0' in docs and add a YAML mapping that lists runtime aliases (q4f). Also update Python and Node snippets to the new SDK patterns.
Lina (devex): For Node, prefer the async iterator stream example. I'll add that and a short callout about streaming vs sync for low-latency UIs.
Tobias (engineer): Dropping a minimal Python snippet for adaptive batching + prefix cache you can paste into the guide:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
res = client.generate('Summarize: key bullets', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=120, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(res.text)
```
Maya (docs): Perfect. Can you add a one-line table explaining batch_policy values (none, fixed-N, adaptive) and when to pick each?
Tobias (engineer): Will add. Also adding this YAML mapping snippet for quant aliases:
```yaml
quant_profiles:
  - name: q4_0
    aliases: [q4f]
    note: "4-bit fast kernel profile; good latency for short seqs"
```
Diego (eng-ml): LGTM. Please include a troubleshooting FAQ: "If your runtime prints q4f in logs, use q4_0 in toolkit config"  that fixed multiple support tickets.
support-bot: PR 1402 opened by @maya/docs: "optimize: standardize quant alias + refresh SDK snippets"  CI checks passed
Maya (docs): I'll merge after Diego thumbs-up on the quant description and Lina's Node snippet. Target: tomorrow midday.
Lina (devex): Node snippet added and small copy edits made. Linking to SDK reference for generate/stream.generate.
Diego (eng-ml): Quick wording tweak to the quant note to avoid implying accuracy gains; clarified that quant affects memory/latency tradeoffs only. Approved.
Maya (docs): Merged. Changelog entry: "Optimize: canonicalize quant profile names, refresh batching/caching snippets, add migration FAQ."
support-bot: PR 1402 merged  docs deploy succeeded
Maya (docs): Thanks all  I'll follow up if support sees more alias-related tickets.
